messages:
elaine: Quick thread — HelioPath case study draft is ready for legal + quote approval. Link: https://drive.redwood/HelioPath-CS-DRAFT. Need final quote approval by EOD Tue. We also want to slot a 30min webinar demo + customer panel the week of Apr 12. Thoughts?
jordan: ✅ reading now. will flag obvious redlines. can we confirm who from HelioPath will join the webinar?
samir: HelioPath will send 2 ppl: CTO (Anya) + Product Dir (Ravi). They said they can demo their integration if we want a short demo segment.
elaine: Perfect. Tentative webinar target: Apr 14 10am PT. @marco can you check MKT calendar & studio? Hold tentative spot for now.
marco: 10am PT looks free. reserving studio + calendar hold. need slide deck + runbook 3 days prior. :movie_camera:
tia: I’ll own slides + runbook. please add me to the doc (I don’t have access yet).
elaine: Access granted. Also legal: @legal-ellie can you review the customer quote block and IP usage? We redacted specific numbers but left a savings claim — may need substantiation.
legal-ellie: Skimmed. Need one minor change: the phrase '95% reduction' requires backup. Recommend either provide substantiation or change to 'substantial reduction' or 'significant reduction'. Also we need a signed release (customer signature) uploaded to Partner Portal before publish.
elaine: Noted. @samir can you request the signed release and any supporting metrics? For public copy, proposed quote: "HelioPath reduced inference costs significantly while improving throughput."
samir: Pinged Anya this morning. She said legal will try to return the release + numbers by Friday. If they can't, we'll use the softened wording.
jordan: Small copy suggestion: change 'inference costs' -> 'inference unit costs (per-token equivalent)' to be more precise.
elaine: Good call — I'll update the draft. Workflow recap: legal approval -> final quote sign-off -> marketing assets -> webinar comms. Who handles inbound lead routing post-webinar?
marco: SDRs get hot leads. I'll add a webhook in the post-event flow to tag leads with 'heliopath-webinar' and route to @samuel-sdr. Also adding a CTA field on the registration form.
deploy-bot: Created calendar event 'HelioPath Customer Webinar — Apr 14 10am PT' and studio booking ref #ST-2026-14.
elia: Tiny ask — can we include alt copy for socials? short + long versions, and a 1-line executive quote card.
tia: Will draft 3 social variants: launch post, benchmark highlight, and customer-quote card. Deliverable due Mon EOD.
elaine: Timeline summary: Mon — social copy + slides; Tue — legal sign-off; Wed — finalize assets; Thu — rehearsal; Apr 14 — webinar. If legal delays, we swap to the moderated quote. Action items tagged in the doc. Please keep replies short — marking thread for actions.
